questions.hint: Tell me, do you like Moscow?
questions.explain: нравиться: the person who likes is in the dative (ты → тебе).
States like жарко, холодно, скучно: the person is in the dative (мне).

questions.hint: Tomorrow I'm going to the doctor.
questions.explain: Going to a person: к + dative (врач → к врачу).
помогать + dative: наш → нашему, сосед → соседу.
Age: the person is in the dative (твоему брату).
The verb agrees with the thing liked: эти песни (plural) → нравятся.

questions.prompt: На этой неделе ___ надо много работать.
questions.hint: This week we have to work a lot.
questions.explain: надо, нужно, можно, нельзя + dative: мы → нам.

questions.prompt: В субботу мы идём в гости к ___.
questions.explain: к + dative; after a preposition им becomes ним.
верить + dative; without a preposition there is no н-: ему.

questions.hint: We walked around the city for a long time.
questions.explain: по (along, around) + dative: город → по городу.

questions.hint: The teacher is explaining the new rule to the students.
Thanks to your help I found a job.

questions.explain: благодарен + dative (but благодарить + accusative: благодарю вас).
Age: the person in the dative + number + год / года / лет.

questions.prompt: We have to call grandma today.
questions.explain: Two datives: надо + dative (нам), звонить + dative (бабушке).
